free_parameters.identification_labels_note: offer_curve_by_group is labelled 'residual' here -- the builder default -- and that is CORRECT for this run and a REAL CHANGE from keeper 4. Keeper 4 carried the identity 1.0 on every band and its committed ledger labelled the entry 'measured-physical'; this run carries 0.93, a value set against the price level through the rules 1/13 authorized channel, so the predecessor's label is deliberately NOT carried forward. offer_curve_smoothing (value unchanged from keeper 4) keeps the predecessor's label; the build_dof_ledger-vs-committed discrepancy on that entry is unresolved and remains SPP-50 R-3. DECLARED-VS-ACTUAL, reported as a miss: PRECOMMIT-spp-52a section 1(e) predicted the ledger would go '3 entries / 1 residual -> 4 entries / 2 residual'. n_residual 1 -> 2 is right; n_entries is WRONG and stays at 3, because the ledger schema counts offer_curve_by_group as ONE entry carrying a dict of scalars, so arming the channel RE-CHARACTERISES an existing entry instead of adding a new one.
free_parameters.inheritance_basis: SPP-61 is the SPP-52a recipe plus one GATED bool (eia860_vintage_tracks_solve_year=true) applied through the registered --set channel. No offer band, structural share, code path or shared default moves, so every ledger entry and every scalar count carries over unchanged. n_entries stays 3 and n_residual stays 2.

governance.authorized_price_tuning_declared: DECLARED AND IN USE. This run tunes SPP's fossil offer curve DOWN 7 % on the price level through the rule 1 [R-STRUCT] / rule 13 [R-MEASURED] authorized channel (owner amendment 2026-09-05), on the owner's explicit instruction: 'first just tune the offer curve down by 7% across all fossil and launch an LP that runs that.' Every condition of the carve-out is met and each is checkable against this run's own run_config.json: (a) the four offer_curve_by_group bands ONLY -- committed/econ_low/econ_high/peak all 0.93 on the ten registered fossil classes SPP dispatches, with NO phys_* field, NO econ_low_share, NO pct_peaking and no adder/offset/haircut/proxy touched (verified: CT_PEAKER keeps econ_low_share 0.526 / pct_peaking 7.0, COAL_PRB 0.55, ST_GAS 0.5 / 15.0, and the three *_INTERMEDIATE curves keep their peak 2.25 / 3.0 / 2.2); (b) ONE config across EVERY scored year -- a single scalar 0.93, no per-year value; (c) set EX ANTE and declared in the PRECOMMIT before the solve, and NEVER swept -- no other multiplier was solved, scored or compared, and the declared value was not revised after its result was seen; (d) merit-order movement across classes is an intended effect; (e) declared here and carried as a ledgered free parameter, identification 'residual' sourced to the ruling. ST_CHP is excluded because it has no registered base curve in SPP's resolved offer_curve_by_group and including it fails the launch with KeyError: 'econ_low_share'.
governance.attested_by: SPP-52a (2026-09-09): SPP keeper 4's recipe (2026-09-09-spp-51c-oversupply-curtailment, which carries the oversupply curtailment allocation and the repaired GMT->fixed-CST actual-LMP clock) plus ONE change, the authorized offer-curve level above. ONE --year 2023 2024 2025 invocation, years sequential (rules 12/16). MEASURED EFFECT, graded against the PRECOMMIT: the load-weighted level falls -6.00 / -5.91 / -6.03 % (declared band 5.0-8.0 %, PASS, and near-perfectly uniform across years, which independently confirms the price-family lane's finding that a uniform quadruple is a LEVEL lever and not a shape lever); C3a +7.80/+5.64/+10.28 -> +1.34/-0.60/+3.63 %, inside +-10 % in all three years; C3b 0.1836/0.1894/0.2043 -> 0.1647/0.1769/0.1755, improving in every year with 2025 clearing <=0.20. REPORTED AGAINST THIS LANE'S OWN INTEREST, both pre-registered: the determination does NOT change -- C3c is pinned at 0/4/2 h against 42/59/68 (SPP has no scarcity mechanism of any kind, SPP-55's object) and the 2024 ST_GAS C1 row is the Harrington fuel-vintage object (SPP-46 R-4) that no offer multiplier reaches. NOT a structural claim: this moves a level and nothing else, and it does not re-open the price-family lane's G-2 steepening refusal. Rule 22: 2023-2025 only; SPP holds no holdout marker and none is spent.

eia860_vintage_tracks_solve_year.source: EIA-860 annual releases, resolved per solve year by config/paths.py::resolve_backcast_eia860_vintage. Zero scalars, zero degrees of freedom: the switch selects WHICH committed release the fleet builder reads, and the content is the release.
eia860_vintage_tracks_solve_year.warrant: Rule 14 [R-ACCURATE] and rule 13 [R-MEASURED]. Unarmed, every backcast year resolves to the canonical 2025 Early Release, so the 2023 and 2024 fleets carry a fuel vintage and a unit population those years did not have. The armed registry is the accurate input; the control's is an estimate silently compensating elsewhere.
eia860_vintage_tracks_solve_year.forward_test: Rule 13's admissibility test is met: the same construction regenerates for a forecast year from the then-current EIA-860 release, and responds to changed conditions. This is not an overlay and pins no outcome to an actual.
eia860_vintage_tracks_solve_year.iso_scope: Rule 25 [R-ISO-SCOPE]: armed per-run through --set on SPP's own bundle. The dataclass default stays False and is registered in _CACHE_KEY_OPTIONAL_FIELDS at that declared value, so every pre-existing cache key of all seven ISOs is byte-stable and no other ISO moves. No fitted number crosses an ISO boundary.
eia860_vintage_tracks_solve_year.first_arm: First arm of this field in any committed run, in any ISO.

disclosures.note: SPP-61 disclosures — reported, not patched (rules 1 / 13 / 14). Inherits SPP-52a's, which inherits keeper 4's.
disclosures.the_repair_makes_the_gated_fit_worse_and: C1 goes from ONE failing row to TWO. Control: 2024 ST_GAS -8.13 TWh (2023 passing with 1.05 TWh of headroom). Arm: 2023 ST_GAS -8.38 TWh and 2024 ST_GAS -9.71 TWh, both out of band. The lane's PRECOMMIT §4 named this exact risk before the solve ('2023 is at real risk and this lane may break it') and pre-committed to keeping the repair regardless. Rule 1 [R-STRUCT] forbids rejecting a structurally correct mechanism because its residual moved the wrong way, and rule 14 [R-ACCURATE] forbids reverting to the estimate that fit better. Reported at full magnitude; never absorbed.
disclosures.what_the_degradation_actually_diagnoses: Model ST_GAS was ALREADY 6.95 / 8.13 TWh below actual before the arm. The arm removes 744.5 / 948.4 MW of ST_GAS and 1,308.0 / 1,282.1 MW of CT_PEAKER capacity that did not exist in 2023 / 2024, which removes a compensating error rather than creating one. The residual is a gas-steam merit-order/offer defect, not a fleet-vintage defect. Routed as the named successor for the C1 ST_GAS row — root-caused, not buried back in the input.
disclosures.what_improves: The control's registry was 60,749.0 / 60,739.9 / 60,739.9 MW across three years — a fleet that barely evolves, which is the pjm-167 defect this field was built for. The arm restores real annual evolution (-2,715.4 MW in 2023, -3,175.3 MW in 2024). D-A 2025 diurnal phase repairs from OFF to OK, and 2023 / 2024 diurnal amplitude rises from 36.9 / 35.2 % to 38.5 / 38.1 % of measured.
disclosures.gates_that_still_fail: C1 on the 2023 and 2024 ST_GAS rows, and C3c in all three years. Neither is reachable by the vintage channel. The determination is NOT-YET, the same determination the control carries; this run is promoted on structural fidelity (rules 1 / 14), never on its score.
disclosures.c5a_co2_moves_the_wrong_way: REPORTED-ONLY (rubric v2.9, contributes no status): -2.6 / -2.0 / +3.0 % becomes -5.6 / -3.1 / +2.9 %. Reported at full magnitude. It tracks the same ST_GAS shortfall and is routed with it.
